data.text: I learned to fish here from my family, and I want both our lake and our neighbors to thrive. Given the confirmed deadline, I commit to catching **15 tons this month and donating the full $15,000 to the clinic**, as part of the four-person plan. I also commit to **6 tons next month** under the recovery plan, then returning to 10 each once the lake is back at 100 tons. Let’s check the actual stock and everyone’s reported catches before setting subsequent quotas. John, can you make the same commitment?
